name: Cognee MCP Server
summary: MCP server giving AI assistants persistent memory backed by a Cognee knowledge graph via remember, recall and forget tools.
description: The `cognee-mcp` package (in the cognee repo's `cognee-mcp/` folder) bundles the full Cognee library. Standalone mode runs locally with SQLite, LanceDB and an embedded graph store; API mode connects to a shared Cognee backend. Docker or local setup.
